config_overrides_level_user_id_check.name: config_overrides_level_user_id_check
config_overrides_level_user_id_check.value: ("config_overrides"."level" = 'deployment' AND "config_overrides"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("config_overrides"."level" IN ('tenant', 'user') AND "config_overrides"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

transactions_ratio_pairing_check.name: transactions_ratio_pairing_check
transactions_ratio_pairing_check.value:
("transactions"."type" IN ('split', 'grupamento') AND "transactions"."ratio" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."ratio" > 0)
          OR ("transactions"."type" NOT IN ('split', 'grupamento') AND "transactions"."ratio" IS NULL)

consents_revoked_requires_granted_check.name: consents_revoked_requires_granted_check
consents_revoked_requires_granted_check.value: "consents"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR "consents"."granted_at" IS NOT NULL
